name: @pipeworx/mcp-open-sanctions

tools.name: search_entities
tools.description: Search global sanctions, watchlists, and PEP (politically exposed persons) databases. Returns matched entities with names, countries, datasets, and sanctions details. Example: search_entities("Vladimir Putin") or search_entities("Huawei", schema="Company"). Requires your own OpenSanctions API key, passed as _apiKey.

query.description: Name or keyword to search (e.g., "Gazprom", "Kim Jong")

_apiKey.description: Your own OpenSanctions API key (BYO — Pipeworx does not supply one; OpenSanctions is a commercial service). Get one at opensanctions.org/api — free for non-commercial use, paid for commercial. For a keyless US sanctions/export-control screen, use the sanctions-screening pack (sanctions_screen) instead.

tools.name: get_entity
tools.description: Get full details for a sanctioned entity by its OpenSanctions ID. Returns all properties including names, addresses, identifiers, sanctions programs, and related entities. Requires your own OpenSanctions API key, passed as _apiKey.

_apiKey.description: Your own OpenSanctions API key (BYO — Pipeworx does not supply one; OpenSanctions is a commercial service). Get one at opensanctions.org/api — free for non-commercial use, paid for commercial. For a keyless US sanctions/export-control screen, use the sanctions-screening pack (sanctions_screen) instead.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-open-sanctions forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the open-sanctions pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
